assertions.subject: Dementia with Lewy bodies
assertions.quote: In all the degenerative dementias the onset of symptoms is associated with already established brain pathology

assertions.subject: Dementia with Lewy bodies
assertions.quote: Brain imaging by means of structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), at a single time point or performed serially, along with positron emission tomography (PET) imaging using 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose PET (FDG-PET), dopaminergic single-photon emission computerised tomography (SPECT) and PET imaging (for DLB) and PET ligands for amyloid and tau are the best established and validated imaging methods for both early and specific diagnosis of dementia subtype

assertions.subject: Alzheimer’s disease
assertions.quote: Brain imaging along with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) biomarkers have helped to establish the ATN (A = amyloid, T = tau, N = neurodegeneration) framework for the diagnosis of AD
